settings.heading: A home that stands out
settings.body: This roofline now runs full-color smart lighting, controlled entirely from the homeowner's phone — one scene for every night of the year. Hidden in the channel by day, unmistakable after dark.

settings.quote: I have been looking for permanent lighting for a little while and I am happy I chose Kilowash. The installation was so quick and the crew was very professional. I have really enjoyed using my lights not only for holiday fun but also for security. Highly recommend.
settings.photo_alt: Brick home lit in red, white and blue permanent lighting

settings.quote: The lighting is great, lights up the back yard nicely. Very bright front yard lighting. Could only put still photos on here or I would show you the best part, the motion — all holiday chasing or still. I love my lights. Thank you so much for the great service. 10 out of 10 for me.
settings.photo_alt: Roofline lighting glowing along the eaves at dusk

settings.quote: Recently had a solar ventilation fan installed on my home by these guys. He was very knowledgeable and made sure I understood how it worked. He even followed up to ensure it was working correctly! Super impressed with the process and results!
settings.photo_alt: Solar attic ventilation fan installed on a shingle roof

settings.quote: This company is very professional. My AC runs half as hard in the summer months — very impressed. Thank you for all the hard and honest work you do!
settings.photo_alt: Solar-powered attic fan mounted near the ridge of a roof

settings.quote: Had a really bad bird issue under my solar panels. These guys came and fixed it with Critter Guard and cleaned up some dead birds for a great price. 10/10 would recommend!
settings.photo_alt: Solar panel array on a shingle roof against a clear blue sky
